selection.basis: The first ten concrete catalog gaps in the fresh data:gaps inventory whose linked research attempts are already status=found. These fields may be added to their exact candidate or variant only if the accepted source directly supports the missing value; otherwise retain the gap and record a source-reuse resolution explaining the limit.

research_route.action: One read-only Luna Max audit of the exact catalog records, found research attempts, and their accepted local source records. Do not browse or edit; identify the strongest exact source, supported value/basis, and any issue that prevents closing the gap.
research_route.integration_rule: The primary writer may add a supported value to the existing candidate facts or exact variant purchase route, add its accepted source ID, and remove only the now-resolved missing-field label. Preserve full-bike versus frame-only basis, size, exact option/trim, source date, measurement/claim class, and purchase market. Never guess an exact value or represent stale/foreign evidence as a current mainland observation.
research_route.stop_rule: Only these ten fields across nine models. Leave any gap open when an accepted source is mismatched, stale for a volatile fact, incomplete, or insufficiently exact; do not change unrelated fields or add sources.

done_criteria: Return field-by-field evidence and caveats for all ten frozen gaps.
Populate only directly supported missing values and add source-reuse resolutions; leave unsupported gaps explicitly open.

Run npm run validate, npm run research:check, npm run coverage:check; accept coverage baseline only if the check flags new protected information. Run npm run check once only if catalog changes affect executable behavior or required gate applies.
Local B88 only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
